items.title: Frozen Food, Biotech Labs and Timberland: $90,000 Across These 3 Specialty REITs Pays $4,968 a Year
items.summary: One of these three landlords owns freezers, one owns forests, and one owns biotech labs. Only one of them has already slashed its dividend, and it still offers the highest yield of the group.

items.title: Weyerhaeuser (WY) Stock Rebounds As Q3 Results Reveal Profit Strain
items.summary: Weyerhaeuser stock just put in a relief bounce, closing at US$20.35 and up a little over 3% since before the numbers hit. That reaction came after Q3 2026 earnings showed net income of US$61m on US$1.9b of revenue, a clear step down from the prior two quarters and a reminder that profit pressure is the real story.
